'''Resilon''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="SGtD" /> located in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
Resilon was inhabited by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|organics]] and their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who worked in the planet's mines. The [[8D smelter droid]]s once led a droid revolt against their owners. They demanded to be treated fairly and refuse to work until they were guaranteed such treatment. Although it was not confirmed, the 8D smelter droids seemed to be involved in the death of one of their
owners during the revolt.<ref name="SGtD" />
